reference.question: Find \(x\) and \(y\) in the system \(\begin{cases}x=y+1\\2x+y=8\end{cases}\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Substitute x=y+1

Substitute \(x=y+1\) into the second equation: \(2(y+1)+y=8\), \(3y=6\), \(y=2\), \(x=3\).
